svg.aria-label: Three memory tiers, working, episodic and semantic, each with its writer and reader, all rendered into one customer record block in the system prompt; the model reads them and never writes money facts

g.text: WORKING · this turn and this flow
conversation_turns: both sides of every turn,
plus event rows for things that happened with
no message (pay-out failed, deposit landed)
flow state and slots (conversationData, kept)
this turn's pack and tool results, in process
written by: the memory writer at the end of every turn;
out-of-band senders through one helper
redacted before storage · dated · 30-day retention
EPISODIC · what happened, read from the source
one batch per turn over the tables that already exist:
journal lines by wallet (settled money) · active holds
(pending pay-outs) · provider requests (deposits, VAS,
fuel, pay-outs with rail status) · pay links · gifts
rendered as movements: kind, amount, state, reference, time
written by: the money flows, exactly as today; no second copy to drift
later: per-account columns on journal lines so the read is indexed
read by: the pack (newest 10), get_transactions, Mission Control
SEMANTIC · who the customer is
habits computed in SQL from events: usual airtime
number and amount, meter, deposit rail, cadence,
who gets sent money
notes the customer stated, each with provenance
language, KYC, pilot flags, opt-outs (kept as today)
written by: the nightly job and a validated "remember" tool;
no model-written memory in v1.4; a number-free summary is a later option
"what do you know about me" and "forget that" are ordinary tools
CUSTOMER RECORD · one block in the system prompt, every turn
the model may quote these numbers and nothing else; the provenance guard checks every figure it speaks against this block and this turn's tool results
